descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S21 Hospital dashboard matches the p72 prototype; Nursing Home reuses the same design

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 The Hospital dashboard matches the source-of-truth prototype (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html, DashboardScreen) in design and functionality (TFA-92598 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T2 The Nursing Home dashboard reuses the Hospital dashboard design (SOW Exhibit B) (TFA-92598 AC 2; TFA-92598 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (DashboardScreen) and the app's two dashboards

When Compare tiles, labels, colours, the All Patients list (name, room, pending task count, status badge), the back arrow and tap-to-open, side by side

Then Hospital matches the prototype; Nursing Home uses the same layout

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side review. Known differences to settle first: 'Done' vs 'Complete' (Q2); the prototype's In Progress / Done rule (Q1); the app's legend line and subtitle (Q7); 'Room' on Nursing Home rows (main shows the unit only)

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
